tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /su khā ba ti k+ṣe tra bhu ha pra kā shā dar+ṣa aṣ+ṭa da sha bha ma bi ha ra tisma// ༄༅/ /bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa gsal ba'i me long phun tshogs bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ su khā ba ti k+ṣe tra bhu ha pra kā shā dar+sha aṣ+ṭa da sha na maḥ bod skad du/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa gsal pa'i me long phun tshogs bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs bya rgod phung po'i sa 'dzin rtser/ /rgyal tshab ma pham la sogs rgyal sras dang / /kun dga' bo sogs dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /rmad byung mdo 'di 'dom mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /li khri'i mtshams sprin gzhon nus 'khyud pa yi/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi sa 'dzin ngogs/ /dmar ser 'od kyi dra bas khebs pa ltar/ /rab mdzes mkhyen pa'i gter gyis bdag skyongs shig /mi brjed 'jig rten 'di nas nub phyogs su/ /zhing khams bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong na/ /dpag yas smon lam mthu las grub pa yi/ /bde ba can du rol de phyag gi gnas/ /lta bas mi ngom pad+ma ra ga'i mdog /mdangs gsal li khri'i rgya mtshor khrus byas bzhin/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od lham me ba/ /'od chags 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i mkha' la thugs rje'i sprin chen 'khrigs/ /'phrin las char 'bebs yon tan glog phreng gsal/ /zab yangs legs bshad 'brug sgra stong sgrogs pas/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid slong la phyag 'tshal/ /phun tshogs bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa la/ /zhing khams yang dag grol ba zhes bya bar/ /gling bzhi 'dzin ma kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /rtsibs kyi mu khyud gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mdun na 'don gtso gnyis skyes dbang / /rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis yongs 'dzin mdzad pa'i mthus/ /kun bzang rin chen snying po'i zhabs drung du/ /rmad byung thugs mchog bskyed la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas gyur pa'i tshe/ /thub dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i zhabs/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba'i mdun sa ru/ /seng ge'i nga ro sgrog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi zla bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od kyis kyang / /cha yi char yang bskrun par mi nus pa'i/ /rab gsal 'od kyi dra bas phyogs bcu yi/ /mtha' yas zhing kun khyab mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /bskal chen bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong phrag /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma'i grangs brnyed kyis/ /grangs dang dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod pa'i/ /dpag med tshe yi mchog brnyes la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi thugs rje mthu stobs mtshungs med dag /sras kyi thu bo'i rnam par shar gyur pa/ /brtse chen spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen gyis/ /rab gus rim gro mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon rtogs lus brtas legs bshad sgra dbyangs can/ /rgyal sras rkang drug ldan pa bgrang yas kyis/ /dri med zhal gyi 'dab stong rgyas pa yi/ /bdun rtsi ngom par 'thung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab yang snod kyi 'jig rten mdzes pa'i dbus/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar sku yi snying po brjid/ /ye shes legs shar bye ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro mun dpyis 'byin mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /in+ḍa ni la karke ta na dang / /zla ba chu shel pad+ma ra ga sogs/ /'od kyi dpag med zhing khams rgyas 'gengs pa'i/ /kha dog phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /brgyad phyed zhal ras bzhad pas bkod pa bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la ma 'dres yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bkod pa bsam yas ngo mtshar lhun grub pa/ /dbyibs legs phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /dman par mos pa so so skye bo dang / /thos sgrogs rgyal ba 'bring po'i yul las 'das/ /yongs su ma chad mtha' yas mu med pa'i/ /rgya tshad phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /zag bcas las nyon rnyog pa ring du bsal/ /tshu rol mthong bas mos rtogs dka' na yang / /rnam kun 'phags pa'i mngon sum spyod yul ba/

/yul can phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /rnam par mi rtog mnyam bzhag ye shes 'bras/ /'bras bu phun tshogs dag pa me long la/ /gsal rdzogs phun sum tshogs par gang 'char ba/ /bskyed rgyu phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /shin tu rnam dag rnam par rig pa'i mtshan/ /ches zab rten cing 'brel legs gzigs pa yi/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dbang 'byor pa yi gzugs/ /'bras bu phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /dpag med 'od dang dpag med sku tshe dang / /dpag med 'khor dang dpag med chos 'khor bskor/ /dpag med mgon po rgyal dbang rol pa'i gnas/ /zhing bdag phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang / /stobs kyi gdung sel 'od gzugs mthu chen thob/ /dpag yas rgyal sras rgyu skar bye bas bskor/ /'khor tshogs phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /skabs gsum pa dang gdeng can dbyangs ldem dang / /dā nu'i bu dang rnam par 'dul skyes dang / /grub pa rigs 'dzin tshogs kyi srid zhu mdzad/ /zhabs 'bring phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /dbang 'byor gzugs mdzes gzigs dang bde gshegs gsung / /gtam bzang gsal dang 'phags chen dam chos ro/ /myos dang ting 'dzin reg bde nyams myong ba/ /ston pa phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /gang gi mtshan thos dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyur bsngos na/ /mtshams med chos spong ma gtogs don grub pa/ /'phrin las phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /sprul pa'i gnyis skyes rin chen ljon pa las/ /legs par bshad pa'i sgra dbyangs stong bsgrags pas/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan cher 'phel ba/ /phan 'dogs phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs kun spangs pas/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan g.yul las rnam par rgyal/ /brgyad dang bcu drug 'jigs pa kun bral ba/ /'jigs med phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/

/nor 'dzin dbang po rtsibs kyi mu khyud dang / /sdom brtson rgyal sras chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi/ /dpag yas smon lam mthu las legs grub pa/ /rten bzang phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /tshig don mi brjed 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang / /chos rabs rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros dang / /zab yang mngon par rtogs pa'i lam po che/ /bgrod lam phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /sems gnas dgu yi sgrub pa'i zhi gnas dang / /yid byed bdun gyi sgrub pa'i lhag mthong gnyis/ /zung 'jug shing rta 'khor lo phun tshogs pa/ /bzhon pa phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /stong nyid mtshan ma med dang smon pa dang / /mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i sgo rnams kyis/ /thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dgar skabs 'byed pa/ /'jug sgo phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /rin chen sna bdun las grub sdong po dang / /'dab stong ze'u 'bru ge sar lte bar bcas/ /brji phyogs min pa rnams su'ang dri bsung 'phro/ /gzhi rten phun tshogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /mngon dga' dga' ldan mkha' spyod skyes rnams kyang / /brtan thob ma nges zhing 'dir gang skyes pa/ /skye ba gcig gis byang chub mngon mdzad phyir/ /dag pa'i zhing gi rgyal po bde ba can/ /de ltar phyag 'tshal zhing gi yon tan rnams/ /phun tshogs bco brgyad sgo nas bsngags pa yis/ /rab dkar skal pa bzang po gang bskrun des/ /phyi ma bdag cag dpon slob lhan cig par/ /bde ba can du pad+ma'i snying po la/ /gos dang bcas pas rdzus skyes gser mdog ldan/ /bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ldan mtshan dpes brgyan/ /mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan par shog /kha khyer tā la'i phreng ba rim bdun ldan/ /rin chen rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing / /dri zhim me tog gsar pa bcal bkram par/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi'i dga' bde'i dpal thob shog /yan lag brgyad ldan chus gang dri med rdzing / /gser gyi bye ma brdal zhing pad+mas khengs/

/blta reg khrus dang btung ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /lus bde sems la dga' ba mchog thob shog /rdzing bu de dag re re'i phyogs bzhi na/ /gser dngul bai ḍūr+ya dang shel rang bzhin/ /rab bkra lta na sdug pa'i them skas la/ /'bebs 'dzeg tshul gyis dga' bde'i dpal thob shog /rin chen rang bzhin ljon pa'i yal 'dab la/ /dril bu g.yer kha rlung gi bskyod pa las/ /dkon mchog gsum dang rnam thar gsum la sogs/ /dam pa chos kyi sgra snyan thob par shog /mgrin sngon ngang pa khrung khrung la sogs pa/ /sprul pa'i 'dab chags chos sgra sgrog pa las/ /skyabs gsum yid la byed pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /dri zhim yan lag brgyad ldan pad+ma'i mtsho/ /rab mdzes sprul pa'i bya tshogs 'phur lding g.yo/ /phun tshogs thams cad 'dod dgur 'byung ba yis/ /phan bde rab 'byams tshad bzung med par shog /steng 'og dpag tshad drug brgya'i dpang dang ni/ /sbom du dpag tshad lnga brgya'i byang chub shing / /mthong thos dran reg bgyis pa de dag rnams/ /zag med dag pa'i snang ba thob par shog /'khor tshogs rgyu skar bye bas yongs bskor bas/ /'od dkar bdag po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /dri med zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gsal mthong nas/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi ngom med 'thung bar shog /snga dro re zhing sangs rgyas zhing gzhan du/ /rgyal ba bye ba phrag 'bum la 'dud cing / /me tog bye ba phrag 'bum sngon gtor nas/ /nyin phyed re zhing slar yang 'ongs bar shog /nang du yang dag 'jog dang sems can don/ /rgyal ba dges pa'i spyod pa goms pa las/ /tshe mthar sa bcu'i rtogs pa mngon gyur te/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog /tshe 'di nyid la'ang bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas/ /tshe rabs gtan du legs rgyu lhag bsam mchog /tshe gang spyod la don gnyis lhun grub shog

/phyi ma zhing mchog bde ba can nyid du/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas spangs rtogs yon tan rnams/ /rim gyis rdzogs nas gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don mang bsgrub par shog /de la rten nas spyi dang bye brag gi /bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rab rgyas shing / /pha mar gyur pa'i rigs drug sems can kun/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du 'dren gyur cig /ces bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa gsal ba'i me long phun tshogs bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge gnyen paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ zhing mchog bde ba can du rang gzhan thams cad skye bar 'dun pa'i dad pa rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis kun nas blangs te/ paṇa chen mi nyag grags pa rdo rje'i gsung rab nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa la kha skong du 'os pa'i tshigs bcad 'ga' zhig bsnan te/ rang lo bzhi bcu lon pa byi lo gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshom dmar gyi chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung du legs par sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad yid la re ba bzhin 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod che/ /stong phrag brgya pa'i gleng gzhi'i le 'u'i don/ /'phags mchog thogs med zhabs kyis bkral ba dang / /gangs can dpal mgon shan+ta rak+ṣi tas/ /bshad dang zhing bkod mdo gnyis dgongs pa bzhin/ /legs par sbyar 'dis bsod nams gang thob des/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bde ba can skyes nas/ /phyin chad las nyon skye sgo chod par shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig /de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /'di'i yi ge pa ni gso ba rig pa dang yi ge la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so//

//sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa gsal ba'i me long phun tshogs bco brgyad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
